_comment: Placeholder entries. Replace with your real downloaded tracks. Each entry: id (unique), file (path relative to music/), mood (one of: calm, uneasy, tense, final). The code checks the file exists before playing, so unreplaced placeholders simply never play. Use pi/audio/import_music.py to regenerate this file from your downloads, or edit by hand. See music/README.md for where to get tracks.
